note: Single model execution on the preview build; not a model-wide benchmark. Known config-validation/loading-timeout/same-search-resubmit issues were out of scope (separate worker).

checks.evidence: H1 'The Book of Genesis'; H2 'A narrative guide' with 8 passage links (#read/1/1 ... #read/37/1) labeled 'Editorial divisions, not source headings'; coverage panel 'Reading text King James Version / 50 chapters / 1,533 verses' vs 'Companion material 4 sourced appendices'; sidebar lists Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy each labeled 'Not yet added' (Genesis 'Available'). Screenshot qa/screenshots/qwen-01-overview.png confirms layout.
checks.limitations: Visual review of screenshot by parent; DOM text extraction is primary proof.

checks.evidence: location.hash=#read/2/4 -> H1 'Genesis 2'; exactly 25 p.verse elements numbered 1..25; verse #v4 has class 'verse selected'; no paragraph-card elements with selection (paras[] empty). Verse 4 text begins 'These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when\r\nthey were created' - CRLF wrap preserved, text not rewritten. /api/library confirms chapter 2 has 25 verses (50 chapters, 1533 verses total).

#chapter-select is BUTTON role=combobox (Radix, not native select). Enter opened role=listbox with 50 role=option items ('1','2✓',...,'50'). End key: polled until activeElement was option '50' (async Radix focus confirmed), then Enter selected: hash=#read/50, H1 'Genesis 50', 26 p.verse numbered 1..26, trigger text '50', listbox removed. /api/library independently confirms chapter 50 has 26 verses.

Initial state recorded via UI: stored='20', computed 20px. Opened #text-size combobox via keyboard (options 18/20/23/26px), ArrowDown x2 to '26px', Enter: computed .verse-text font-size=26px, localStorage['scripture-library:size']='26'. location.reload(): still 26px + stored '26' (persists). Restored to 20px through the same menu UI (ArrowUp x2, Enter): stored='20', computed 20px. No direct storage writes.
checks.limitations: Tab was backgrounded (visibilityState=hidden); Radix Select required Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled(true) to open via keyboard — harness artifact, not an app defect; emulation was disabled in finally. Note: after reload, Enter-open initially failed while tab hidden; with focus emulation it opened normally.

checks.evidence: For both #chapter-select and #text-size: Enter opened listbox (opened=true), Escape closed it (listbox removed, aria-expanded=false) and document.activeElement returned to the same trigger (focusId=chapter-select / text-size, role=combobox). No lost focus.
checks.limitations: Tested with keyboard events via CDP; tab hidden but focus emulation not needed for these opens (they succeeded). Actually opens worked without emulation this time.

checks.evidence: Typed 'earth was' into #search-input, submitted form via Enter: hash=#search/earth%20was, H1 'Search Genesis', '4 verses matching', results include Genesis 1:2 (href #read/1/2) even though the stored verse text contains CRLF wrap ('darkness was upon\r\nthe face of the deep'). Clicked the Genesis 1:2 result -> hash #read/1/2, H1 'Genesis 1', 31 verses, p.verse#v2 has class 'selected'. No-result query 'zzzqqqxyz': '0 verses matching' plus readable empty state 'No matching verses. Try a shorter word or wording from the King James Version.'

Clicked 'Theological appendices' nav link -> #appendices, H1 'Theological appendices' listing 4 notes. Opened #note/creation-days-and-time: H1 'Creation days and the beginning of time'; badge 'Editorial synthesis / Distinct from the biblical text'; 3 blockquotes with actual attributed text and cites: Luther 'With respect therefore to this opinion of Augustine, we conclude that Moses spoke literally...' (cite: Martin Luther — Commentary on Genesis Vol.1, Ch. I, frozen source lines 1965-1970), Augustine 'But if any excursive brain rove over the images of forepassed times...' (Confessions Book XI, lines 6944-6957), Luther 'With respect to Martin Luther before you...' (Ch. II, lines 5210-5226). Quote text preserves CRLF wraps. Source links present (href validated only, not clicked): https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/48193 (Luther), https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/3296 (Augustine). Passage links: #read/1/1, #read/1/31, #read/2/1.
checks.limitations: External URLs not clicked per instructions; only href attributes validated.

checks.evidence: #sources H1 'Sources & method'; Bibliography lists 4 works each with Edition / Translator-editor / Coverage / Rights fields (e.g. KJV: 'Project Gutenberg eBook 10; text updated October 29, 2024', 'King James Version translators; individual translators not credited', 'Rights: Public domain in the USA. Full Gutenberg notices and license retained'). Relative local copies linked: raw/kjv.txt, raw/luther1.txt, raw/luther2.txt, raw/augustine.txt. Same-origin fetch('/raw/kjv.txt') -> 200 text/plain; charset=utf-8, 4,451,854 chars, starts 'The Project Gutenberg eBook of The King James Version of the Bible\r\n' (preserved source text incl. CRLF). Extra grounding: API sourceStart/sourceEnd slices for Gen 1:1 and 1:2 match raw file exactly. fetch('/application/.env') -> 404 (body not read).
checks.limitations: Only one raw link fetched per instructions; other three verified as hrefs only.

checks.evidence: Theme: initial data-theme=dark (ls 'scripture-library:theme'='dark', bg rgb(14,14,14)). Clicked 'Light mode' button -> data-theme=light, bg rgb(255,255,255), button flips to 'Dark mode'; location.reload() keeps light (ls persisted). Restored to dark via the same button at end. Mobile: Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride calibrated so window.innerWidth==390 exactly (harness proxy scales overrides by 1/0.9; set 351x760 -> observed 390x844). Reader #read/2/4 at 390: documentElement.scrollWidth==clientWidth==390, zero elements with right>391. Overview #home at 390: same, no overflow. Chapter menu open at 390: listbox rect x=63 w=61 (right=124<=390), y=395 h=320 (bottom=715<=844) inside viewport; text-size menu rect x=167 w=76, y=395 h=129 inside. Menu asserted open before and after screenshot (open after shot: True). Screenshot qa/screenshots/qwen-02-reader-390-chaptermenu.png. Cleanup: setDeviceMetricsOverride re-applied at harness baseline (1672x947 dpr2 -> observed 1858x1052 dpr1.8, matching session start) and setFocusEmulationEnabled(false) in finally; no browser zoom touched.
checks.limitations: Harness CDP proxy makes Emulation.clearDeviceMetricsOverride a no-op (viewport stuck at last override); restoration was done by re-applying the exact baseline override instead. One intermediate tab got stuck at 355px and was closed (it was my own extra tab, not a pre-existing one).

checks.evidence: #read/999 -> H1 'Page not found', breadcrumb 'Unknown reference', text 'This reference is not in the current library. Return to Genesis.' Malformed #search/% -> same 'Page not found' screen (hash stays #search/%). history.back() from #search/% -> #read/999 (Page not found, correct prior entry); back again -> #home 'The Book of Genesis'; forward -> #read/999; forward -> #search/% — each screen matches its route. Ending route restored to #read/2/4 (H1 'Genesis 2'), 0 listboxes open, both comboboxes aria-expanded=false. Screenshot qa/screenshots/qwen-03-final-read-2-4.png.

environment_observations: Harness CDP proxy scales Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride by ~1/0.9 and its clearDeviceMetricsOverride is a no-op on this backend; baseline was restored by re-applying the harness's own override (observed 1858x1052 dpr1.8, identical to session start).

Tab runs backgrounded (visibilityState=hidden); Radix Select keyboard opening intermittently required Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled(true), disabled in finally. Harness artifact, not an app defect.
One extra tab opened during viewport diagnosis got stuck at 355px due to the proxy clear bug and was closed; it was created by this QA run, not pre-existing.
